title: Mast-Jägermeister SE – Enterprise Transformation
summary: Shopify Enterprise Transformation. Migration of a headless/Contentful setup to a native Shopify theme. Development of a custom app for automated content sync between master and country shops. Custom features like label/engraving editor. CI/CD & Git workflows in an international enterprise environment.

sections.text: The existing Shopify setup was based on a complex headless architecture with Contentful integration and international commerce structures. The goal was to technically simplify the system landscape and return to a high-performance and long-term maintainable native Shopify theme within an international enterprise environment.

Collaborated on the conception and implementation of scalable Shopify theme structures using Liquid, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Shopify APIs. Supported the development of a custom Shopify app for automated content sync between the master shop and country shops. Additionally, provided technical evaluation and implementation of complex features such as interactive storefront elements, label/engraving editors, and integrations of external systems like SAP and Salesforce.

Creation of a maintainable, high-performance, and scalable Shopify architecture with professional CI/CD workflows, a clean deployment structure, and optimized international content processes. Improved technical maintainability and a stable foundation for the long-term further development of the global Shopify ecosystem.

title: Dekoback GmbH – Multi-Store Setup & Technical Consulting
summary: Long-term support of a multi-store setup and WordPress structures. Frontend development of a custom theme for the 'Einfach Backen' shop. Integration of GA4, GTM, Klaviyo, and app configurations. Performance optimization.

sections.text: Supporting an extensive multi-store setup with several Shopify stores and complementary WordPress structures in the food commerce environment. The existing infrastructure required continuous technical development, performance optimization, and stable processes for content, tracking, and shop management.

Development and adjustment of individual Shopify theme functions with Liquid, HTML, CSS, and TypeScript/JavaScript. Implementation of new sections, landing pages, and conversion-oriented shop adjustments. Integration and configuration of external systems like GA4, GTM, Klaviyo, and GitHub, as well as technical quality assurance, debugging, and performance optimization of existing theme structures.

Stable and scalable multi-store infrastructure with improved loading times, optimized Core Web Vitals, and more efficient technical processes. Long-term technical support ensured a reliable further development of the existing commerce and content landscape.

title: Overkill Shop – Technical Checkout Rescue
summary: Analysis and stabilization of business-critical checkout and payment processes within a high-traffic Shopify store. Focus on technical error analysis, stability during peak traffic, and optimization of conversion-relevant storefront processes.

sections.text: Within a heavily frequented Shopify store, technical problems occurred in the checkout and payment process, especially during high traffic spikes during exclusive product releases. The goal was the technical stabilization of critical purchase processes and ensuring a reliable user experience.

Analysis of existing Shopify theme and storefront processes as well as identification of technical error sources within checkout-relevant workflows. Optimization of technical structures, stabilization of payment and frontend logic, and improvement of UX-relevant user flows within the purchase process.

Improved stability and reliability of the checkout process even under high load. Reduction of technical errors and stabilization of conversion-critical shop areas to ensure a reliable ordering process with high visitor numbers.

title: FeDu Werkstatttechnik – Store Relaunch & B2B Integration
summary: Structured relaunch using the Horizon theme. Setup of a metafield architecture for linking product-related data. Configuration of Shopify Search & Discovery, filter logic, and B2B catalogs.

sections.text: Relaunch of the Shopify store focusing on B2B functionalities and an improved product data structure for technical items.
Setup of a metafield architecture for efficient linking of product-related data. Configuration of Shopify Search & Discovery and individual filter logic based on the Horizon theme.
A powerful B2B store with optimized search functionality and clearly structured product catalogs that meet the requirements of professional customers.

title: Rocketcommerce.io – Custom Solutions & Product Configurators
summary: Development of technically demanding product configurators for various agency clients (e.g., MyVoltaics, Zauntastisch). Implementation of complex pricing logic, variant structures, and selection processes.

sections.text: Implementation of individual e-commerce features for agency clients that go beyond the standard range of functions of Shopify.
Development of complex product configurators with JavaScript and Liquid. Implementation of variable pricing logic and dynamic variant structures for products such as solar systems and fence systems.
Highly individualized storefront tools that simplify complex purchasing decisions and increase the conversion rate.

title: Latori GmbH – Enterprise Shopify projects
summary: Senior Shopify Frontend Developer for Enterprise Shopify projects. Development of demanding frontend features (PDP, PLP, Cart Drawer) for premium brands (e.g., micasa, Delica, ooia). Work in professional GitHub workflows.

sections.text: Implementation of complex Shopify frontend functionalities for enterprise and premium brand projects within a Shopify Plus agency environment.
Development of high-performance storefront components such as PDPs, PLPs, and cart drawers based on pixel-perfect designs. Use of TypeScript and modern GitHub workflows including code reviews.
Scalable and maintainable frontend architectures for high-traffic Shopify projects with highest quality standards.

title: Heskamp Medien GmbH – Technical Consulting
summary: Technical support and consulting for web and e-commerce projects in an agency environment. App configurations, checkout optimization, and connection of marketplaces (Amazon Seller Central).

sections.text: Technical consulting for various customer projects with a focus on process optimization and system connection.
Configuration of complex app setups, optimization of the checkout to increase conversion, and connection of external marketplaces like Amazon.
Optimized technical processes and improved connection to third-party systems, leading to more efficient e-commerce workflows.

title: Natsana GmbH – Technical Interviewer & Assessment
summary: Support in the recruiting process for a Shopify developer position. Conducting technical assessments and technical evaluation of candidates regarding frontend competence and Shopify experience.

sections.text: Qualitative support in selecting new technical team members for Shopify development.
Conducting in-depth technical interviews and evaluating candidates regarding their Shopify and frontend expertise.
Successful filling of technical vacancies through technically sound assessments and well-founded decision bases for management.

title: Coberi GmbH – Technical E-Commerce Consultant
summary: Consulting with a focus on tracking and marketing integrations. Setup of GA4, GTM, Google Ads conversion tracking (Consent Mode), and Klaviyo flows. Construction of a Looker Studio dashboard.

sections.text: Ensuring a clean data basis for marketing decisions in a Shopware environment.
Implementation of a comprehensive tracking setup including Consent Mode and GTM. Automation of marketing flows in Klaviyo.
Transparent success measurement via Looker Studio dashboards and more efficient marketing campaigns through precise tracking.

title: ERP Integration – Shopify & Xentral
summary: Technical connection of Xentral ERP to a Shopify store. Configuration of article master data, variants, images, metafields, as well as warehouse and shipping processes.

sections.text: Merging e-commerce and ERP to automate operational processes.
Configuration of the interface between Shopify and Xentral. Mapping of product data, variants, and metafields, as well as definition of warehouse workflows.
Synchronized data stocks and automated order processing, which significantly reduces manual effort.

title: travel tiger – Performance & Theme Optimization

sections.text: Improving the technical performance of a high-reach outdoor shop to increase organic visibility.

Faster loading times and a more stable storefront, which has a positive effect on Google ranking and user experience.

title: Derdak und Saitta – Data Integration & Automation

sections.text: Automation of complex supplier feeds for a dropshipping business.
Use of tools like Matrixify and EasyCSV for the transformation and import of CSV data. Setup of a regular inventory sync.
A largely automated system for product maintenance and inventory management without manual intervention.

title: IT Service Provider of the Bundeswehr – Software Development

sections.text: Development of enterprise applications in a highly regulated and security-critical environment.
JavaScript-based feature development within agile sprints. Focus on complete documentation and CI/CD processes.
Reliable software solutions that meet the strict quality and security requirements of the public sector.
